subject: Key provenance snapshot & export request
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearharbor.com>, audit@clearharbor.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Key provenance snapshot & export request

Hi Lisa / ClearHarbor audit team,

Following up on the SOC 2 / SIG intake — we need a concise snapshot of key provenance and recent rotation activity for tenant-scoped BYOK keys used for Redwood production storage. To keep the request scoped for the auditor: can you provide the following artifacts for the past 90 days (rolling window ending today)?

- HSM shift logs that show operator handoffs and seal/unseal events (CSV preferred).
- KMS key metadata export (key IDs hashed, key creation timestamps, algorithm/bit-strength, and current role assignments).
- Rotation events (UTC timestamps + operator id) and confirmation of automated vs manual rotations.
- Transport manifests / checksums for any exported key material (if exports occurred).
- A short attestation (one paragraph) from your operations team confirming the export was performed under account-level controls and that private key material was never stored unencrypted outside the HSM.

If you cannot share raw key material, hashed key IDs + signed manifests are fine. For transfer method we prefer an SFTP drop with a signed manifest (SHA256) or a secure ShareFile link. We need these artifacts by EOD Friday 2026-05-22 to meet our auditor deadlines.

Also note: we will redact operator IDs in any public-facing reports but need the full operator IDs for internal cross-checks. If there are retention constraints on any of the files listed above, please call out the limitation and provide the closest substitute.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa and Rishi for visibility.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: request-checklist.txt (no binary)
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearharbor.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Key provenance snapshot & export request

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear list. We can produce most of this within the window. Quick notes:

- HSM shift logs: attached sample (hsm_shiftlog_202602-202605.csv). This contains operator shift start/end and custody events. We have redacted session tokens but left operator aliases per your redaction note.
- KMS metadata export: we can provide a CSV with hashed key IDs (sha256(key_id) format), algorithm, creation_ts, and role assignment.
- Rotation events: available as an append-only audit stream; we can export the last 90 days in CSV.
- Exports: there was one sealed export (approved emergency procedure) on 2026-04-13. We can include the signed manifest and the DocuSign approval reference.

We will not include any unencrypted private key material. Delivery options: SFTP (preferred) or a pre-authorized ShareFile link. We will place the files under an encrypted container and provide the SHA256 manifest.

I am attaching the shift log CSV and the sealed-export-manifest.pdf (signed).

Let me know the SFTP credentials or if you prefer we provision a one-time link.

Cheers,
Lisa Chen
Head of Security Operations
ClearHarbor Finance

Attachments: hsm_shiftlog_202602-202605.csv (CSV), sealed-export-manifest.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearharbor.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Key provenance snapshot & export request

Thanks Lisa — this looks good. A couple of follow-ups from the Redwood side so we can close evidence mapping: 

- For the KMS metadata export, can you include the internal key alias mapping that shows tenant->key_id (we're fine with alias -> hashed key id). That lets our control owner map to tenant records without exposing raw key IDs.
- For rotation events, can you confirm whether rotations were automated by your KMS scheduler or performed manually by the operator for the entries in April? A boolean column (automated: true/false) is sufficient.
- The sealed-export-manifest.pdf: can you add the DocuSign envelope id in the manifest body (if it's present) so we can reference it in the auditor appendix?

We can provide a short runbook excerpt showing how Redwood ingests a sealed export (we will include the sanitized checklist and a sample checksum verification script). Attaching the internal guidance we will send back with our checklist (redwood-byok-procurement-guidance.pdf).

If SFTP is easiest, please send the host + user + desired path (we'll coordinate intake with infra). Otherwise share the secure link and we'll download using a dedicated transfer account.

Appreciate the quick turn.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-byok-procurement-guidance.pdf (internal guidance)
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearharbor.com>

DocuSign envelope id for the sealed export is DS-2026-0413-CH; you'll see it referenced in sealed-export-manifest.pdf.
